name: pnp-sp-dev-spfx-web-parts-mslearn-module-deployment
title: Deploy SharePoint Framework components to production
shortDescription: A SharePoint Framework (SPFx) solution that you package and deploy to the tenant and site collection app catalogs, then extend with more components and new package and component versions.
longDescription: A SharePoint Framework (SPFx) solution that you package and deploy to the tenant and site collection app catalogs, then extend with more components and new package and component versions.
This tutorial contains the completed code for the exercises in the Microsoft Learn module Deploy SharePoint Framework components to production.

references.name: Microsoft Learn: Deploy SharePoint Framework components to production

references.name: Overview of the SharePoint Framework
references.description: The SharePoint Framework (SPFx) is a page and web part model that provides full support for client-side SharePoint development, easy integration with SharePoint data, and extending Microsoft Teams, Microsoft Viva, Outlook, and Microsoft 365.
